About

Patrick Makary is a founder in the making, redefining what ambition can become. Through Patrick Makary Group, he builds structures engineered for scale, influence, and longevity—foundations designed not for a moment, but for an era. Patrick leads with precision, discipline, and a long-term vision meant to outlast noise, trends, and every imposed limit.

Driven by Medicine, Business, Art, and Sport, he shapes a multifaceted identity rooted in purpose and resilience. Patrick isn't here to adapt to the world—he's here to reshape it, set new standards, and construct an empire built to endure and carry his name forward for generations.
